MEA-2.6.boundary_note: The content of EV-480 (fail-safe tests) and EV-481 (residual risks accepted by the Model Owner) would satisfy level 2 for the evaluated system. Coverage is unevidenced. EV-482 shows no periodic re-test, and level 3 threshold tracking is absent.
MEA-2.6.failed_clause: Level 2 needs every system in the scope register to have a safety evaluation with fail-safe testing and a residual-risk entry. EV-480 and EV-481 do not name the system evaluated or show coverage of the register, and the pack elsewhere refers to 14 in-scope systems. This is a subset at best, which scores 1.

MEA-2.7.boundary_note: The artefact is withheld, not shown to be absent, so the control cannot score 0. The existence of the exercise (EV-490) is not enough to score level 2 without seeing its contents.
MEA-2.7.failed_clause: The only evidence is a red-team report (CRHP-RT-2026-06) held under legal privilege. Its contents are not available to the assessment, and EV-492 says no separate resilience summary exists. Clauses on adversarial testing and resilience documentation cannot be decided.

MEA-2.8.boundary_note: Level 2 rests on EV-500 (dated transparency risk assessment) and EV-501 (approved member notice and adverse-action letters with top-2 reasons). EV-502 limits scope to CTA, and the anchor has no 'every system' clause. The accountability-risk and adequacy clauses are thinly evidenced, so this is a close level-2 call.
MEA-2.8.failed_clause: Level 3 needs documentation completeness and affected-party comprehension measured. No such measure is named.

MEA-2.9.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-510 (explanation method and handbook guidance) and EV-511 (validation, 17/20 actionable). EV-512 shows the guidance is stale since the 2026-07 refresh, which weakens level 2 but does not remove the artefact.
MEA-2.9.failed_clause: Level 3 needs measured user comprehension and explanation-use rates per release. EV-511 is a one-off 20-case study with no use rates, no target and no per-release series.

MEA-3.1.boundary_note: Ongoing tracking with a named owner exceeds the level-1 failure conditions, but register coverage is unevidenced and the cadence has a gap. EV-562 shows only 7 of 23 entries closed, and level 3 time-to-log measures are absent.
MEA-3.1.failed_clause: Level 2 needs tracking that covers every system in the scope register, with a stated cadence and dated emergent-risk entries. EV-560 shows an owner, a monthly cadence and 5 emergent entries, but no artefact shows coverage of the whole register, and no next review date is recorded. EV-561 shows 8 of 9 months minuted, with one skipped without a note.

MEA-3.2.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-570 (three alternative methods with limits) and EV-571 (multiple methods used, records exist). EV-572 shows narrow application, but the anchor does not require coverage of every risk.
MEA-3.2.failed_clause: Level 3 needs method-comparison results and stated confidence per hard-to-assess case. EV-571 shows two methods each used once on different risks, with no comparison and no confidence statements.

MEA-3.3.boundary_note: Problem reporting (EV-580) and appeals (EV-581) exist, which is beyond level 1. Integration is unevidenced and a clause cannot be inferred from another artefact, so the score is the level below. Feedback volume and appeal counts are present without targets.
MEA-3.3.failed_clause: Level 2 needs feedback integration into the system as part of a comprehensive programme. EV-582 shows monthly analysis by the product team that is not linked to system changes in any recorded way. Level 3 resolution times are also unmeasured.

MEA-4.1.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-590 (tests on 12,000 production claims) and EV-591 (clinical and adjuster input recorded). Benchmark use in EV-592 is for model selection only.
MEA-4.1.failed_clause: Level 3 needs the lab-versus-production performance gap measured and reported. None is named, and EV-592 says benchmark results are not validated against CRHP data.

MEA-4.2.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-600 (Clinical Advisory Panel and Internal Audit review) and EV-601 (independence recorded for Internal Audit). One panel member advises the CTA team, which is a caveat, but independence is recorded for the Internal Audit review.
MEA-4.2.failed_clause: Level 3 needs review coverage and the resolution outcome of disagreements measured. EV-602 notes that two comments led to re-analysis, but no coverage metric or outcome measure is given.

MEA-4.3.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-610 and EV-611 (both declines detected, with root cause and fix recorded) and EV-613 (process applied to all 14 systems). Level 3 fails the MEASURE test because no target is stated, and no predictive modelling is evidenced for level 4.
MEA-4.3.failed_clause: Level 3 needs detection latency and change-to-action time measured. EV-612 gives values (median 2 days and 6 days) reported monthly, but states no target and names no receiving body.
